india.one_line: India sees AI talent growth, sovereign model debate, and governance funding.

themes.title: Karnataka leads AI talent hub
themes.text: A Zinnov‑KDEM report released at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 shows Karnataka hosts 1,088 global capability centres, 51% of India’s total, and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, including over 120 dedicated AI/ML Centres of Excellence.

stories.headline: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, new report finds

themes.title: Token Factory hosts Chinese models
themes.text: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory inference platform, launched on November 16, offers eight open‑weight models via an OpenAI‑compatible API on Indian GPU clusters, six of which are from Chinese firms, and received a ₹98.68 crore government GPU subsidy, prompting a sovereign AI debate.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory hosts mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, sparking sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Disseqt AI secures $8M
themes.text: Irish‑headquartered Disseqt AI raised $8 million in a round led by Gresham House Ventures to expand its enterprise AI governance platform, open a London office, and increase hiring in India.

stories.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8 million to expand enterprise AI governance platform
